text.content: The Vela Systems canvas has been the teaching vehicle across the whole module. Every concept, every design decision, every failure mode was first worked through on that shared canvas so the architecture principles were visible before you had to apply them on your own. This lesson is where that scaffolding comes away.

rich_text.plain_text: The Vela Systems canvas has been the teaching vehicle across the whole module. text.content: What you are working with now is your own project canvas: the archetype you chose (Router, Coordinator, or Evaluator) built on a domain you defined, reflecting the architecture brief you wrote in Sprint 1, the multi-agent design you produced in Sprint 2, and the memory and state specification you completed in Sprint 3. Those three documents are the design you are now implementing. The job in this lesson is to apply them systematically: audit the current state of the canvas against what the design specifies, identify every gap, and close each one, then verify that the failure modes from the previous lesson do not exist in your implementation.
